**Regulation to analyze:** FTC Safeguards Rule, 16 CFR Part 314
**Why:** Settlement/title, appraisal and lease-finance operations are directly covered, and the rule's enumerated elements (qualified individual, risk assessment, MFA, encryption, testing, IR plan, board report) give a concrete, legally grounded gap-analysis checklist; FTC also treats it as a benchmark of 'reasonable security' under Section 5 for brokerages and property managers not strictly covered.
